# `scope_get_track_mode`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read the current tracking mode name and the list of selectable modes.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0x81390 (64-bit build) |

Live mount query returning the current tracking mode name, the driver list of modes and the current index. Value sets are driver defined and unresolved. Served by the guider process (TCP 4400); a client on the main command port reaches it through the imager unknown-method relay, which is unavailable to guest-table clients. The native-handler grade below does not describe the relay. Mount serial (firmware 9.31, READ): :GT.

Side effects: Live query of the connected mount through the native mount layer; no motion or setting change is established. Tier C rests on the supplied native mount query path; other runtime-selected mount implementations are unresolved. The driver list is formatted by the call.

| `Timestamp` | string | no | - | (error) Decimal string `<seconds>.<nanoseconds>` with exactly nine fractional digits, formatted with `%ld.%09ld` from clock_gettime clock id 1. Linux clock id 1 is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so the value is monotonic time, not wall-clock or Unix time (INFERRED from the clock id). On replies it is added by the socket layer and is normally present; receivers MUST NOT require it on replies (absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply). ## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":5,"method":"scope_get_track_mode"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_get_track_mode","result":{"name":"sidereal","list":["sidereal","lunar","solar"],"index":0},"code":0,"id":5}
```

Reply, err-315:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_get_track_mode","error":"mount is not connected","code":315,"id":6}
```
